question: Mosquito belongs to ________ phylum of the animal kingdom.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arthropoda.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mosquito **belongs to the **phylum Arthropoda** in the animal kingdom.
 
• The Arthropoda phylum includes **insects, spiders, crustaceans**, and other arthropods. 
 
• **Arthropods are characterized by their jointed appendages and exoskeletons.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mosquitoes** are further classified as members of the family Culicidae within the order Diptera, which also includes flies.
 
• **Ctenophora is a phylum of marine animals commonly known as comb jellies.**
 
• **Chordata is a phylum that includes animals with spinal cords such as mammals and fish.**
 
• **Mollusca **is a phylum of animals that includes **snails, clams, and octopuses.**
